versions.changelog:
Initial release of the gold-investment skill.

- Provides real-time gold price queries (USD/oz, RMB/g).
- Offers technical indicator analysis (RSI, MACD, moving averages).
- Includes news and fundamental analysis (central bank purchases, geopolitical factors, US dollar/bonds, Fed policy).
- Generates structured analysis reports with price overview, technical/fundamental insights, and risk tips.
- Requires TAVILY_API_KEY environment variable for data access.

Gold Investment Skill 1.0.0 – Initial Release

- 提供黄金实时价格查询，包括国际金价和国内金价。
- 支持黄金技术指标分析：RSI、MACD、均线等。
- 集成基本面分析，如央行动态、美联储政策、美元等因素。
- 自动提供价格概览、技术信号、基本面影响及风险提示的完整分析报告。
- 通过 Tavily API 搜索获取实时黄金相关数据。
